Name: Simple Bundle Indicator
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]🎁 Simple Bundle Indicator[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#A7F3D0]PC & Android · Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ · SMAPI 4.3.2+[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]See which items are still needed for unfinished Community Center bundles. Highlight useful items with a slot border, a small bundle icon, or both. Choose where indicators appear and customize their look.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙ Choose Your Indicators[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Display style:[/b] Icon only · Border only · Both · Off. The default remains the original red border, with the small bundle icon off. Borders sit behind the item, quality star and stack count.

[b]Appearance presets:[/b] Vanilla restores red borders only; Minimal uses a smaller 16-pixel icon only; Custom enables both indicators and your custom PNGs. Presets apply when you Save and retain your saved X/Y positions and custom file paths. Choose Keep current for individual edits.

[b]Fine controls:[/b] Icon size from 8–32 UI pixels, separate icon and border opacity from 0–100%, and horizontal/vertical icon offsets from −64 to +64 UI pixels. Icon size is capped to fit the inventory slot.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🎒 Choose Where Markers Appear[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Separate switches control your Inventory tab, chest grids, the player inventory inside bundle menus, and supported shop player inventory grids and desktop crafting inventories. Inventory, chests and bundle-menu player items are enabled by default; shop/crafting inventories are off by default. Android crafting has no backpack grid to mark.

Only your inventory items are marked inside the bundle menu. Requirement pictures, donated slots, bundle icons and decorative artwork stay clear. Toolbars and held-item drawings remain unmarked. Unknown custom menus are excluded; menus that replace normal inventory drawing may need their own integration. Supported scrolling inventory grids are recognized.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🎨 Custom Icons & Borders[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Enable custom artwork and put [b]marker.png[/b] and [b]border.png[/b] directly inside the SimpleBundleIndicator folder. You can also choose relative PNG paths inside that folder. The included [b]marker.example.png[/b] and [b]border.example.png[/b] provide starting points; copy or rename them to the configured filenames to use them.

Each PNG can be up to 512 × 512 pixels and 4 MiB. A border must be square, at least 8 × 8 pixels, with its central half transparent so items stay visible. Missing or invalid files fall back independently to the original red artwork. Save settings or reload your save after changing artwork.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]👀 Preview & Save[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Use optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for a live sample-item preview, appearance presets, visibility switches, file paths and position controls. Reset position returns both offsets to zero. Save applies your changes; Cancel discards unsaved edits. GMCM’s Default button restores and saves the original defaults.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#D8B4FE]Settings previews show controlled native GMCM renders.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌱 What Gets Marked[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Items are checked against current bundle requirements, donation progress and minimum quality. Smaller stacks are marked too: one Gold Parsnip is still useful toward a requirement of five. Normal and remixed Community Center bundles are supported.

Indicators disappear when the requirement is completed. Marked items remain usable normally. Vault money requirements and the abandoned JojaMart’s Missing Bundle are excluded; markers stop on the Joja route or after completing the Community Center.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌍 Languages[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]English · Korean · Simplified Chinese · Spanish · Brazilian Portuguese · Russian · Turkish · German · French · Japanese · Italian · Hungarian[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Install & Configure[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.3.2+ and Stardew Valley 1.6.15+. For Android, use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44436]NRT SMAPI 4.3.2.5 port[/url] with Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3. The same download includes Android inventory drawing and scaled-slot alignment. Extract [b]SimpleBundleIndicator[/b] into your Mods folder. If an older installation uses a [b]CCBundleIndicator[/b] folder, remove that older folder to avoid duplicate copies.

GMCM is optional; choose a release compatible with your platform. Without it, close the game and edit the generated [b]config.json[/b]; the included [b]Quick-Start.txt[/b] explains the appearance and menu controls. To remove the mod, delete its folder.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Have a bug or an idea? Post it on this page. For bugs, include the mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform, what happened versus what you expected, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. A screenshot or short video helps with positioning issues. For suggestions, explain what you would like changed and how it would help.[/color][/size][/center]
